title: Oakley once glimpsed our very illustrious sister H.P.B.’s elemental
html_source:
Present at Blavatsky’s death. Elemental (Gifford) is the lower or physical form of existence within the Theosophy hierarchy.

Also (Gifford), elemental is a pun on Blavatsky’s genitals.

This isn’t unusual for Joyce : Chapter 2 of Portrait, Boland is slagging Stephen off for liking Lord Byron’s

poetry only for Stephen to retort with a couplet of Boland’s construction on some slates in the schoolyard.

As Tyson was riding into Jerusalem
he fell and hurt his Alec Kafuzalem
